arguments.script: var s=UnityEngine.Resources.Load<UnityEngine.Shader>("KingdomWater"); foreach(var e in UnityEditor.ShaderUtil.GetShaderMessages(s)) UnityEngine.Debug.Log(e.severity+": "+e.message); UnityEngine.Debug.Log("shader supported="+s.isSupported+" scene="+UnityEngine.SceneManagement.SceneManager.GetActiveScene().name);
arguments.summary: Check final shader diagnostics without changing current gameplay
